resolution: effective src_64; cited winners are app-assets/output/assets/src_64

backend_modifications_checked.backend_change: MID1 evaluates DailyResetCoordinator after player resolution and before temporal materialization/bootstrap detail
backend_modifications_checked.finding: TOKEN immediately consumes the bundled login detail; detail[17] is applied as PlayerInfo and detail[112] as WorldMap. Daily state therefore must be current before MID1 returns, not repaired by a later request.

backend_modifications_checked.backend_change: MID1 uses the repository authoritative ServerClock for response.server_time
backend_modifications_checked.finding: extraWebResponseCheck_ resets xyd.ServerTime from response.server_time before normal TOKEN model processing. One backend clock must therefore drive reset, temporal materialization, and the projected client epoch.

backend_modifications_checked.backend_change: MID1 detail[17] must contain reset purchase counters and non-future temporal anchors
backend_modifications_checked.finding: PlayerInfo directly assigns Energy/Spirit anchors, daily purchase counters, Skill Point balance and skill_time from server payload. Stale/future values are immediately authoritative to the client.

backend_modifications_checked.backend_change: future Energy, Spirit Energy and Skill Point anchors below cap are rebased to now without changing balances
backend_modifications_checked.finding: All three enabled pools call recoverByTime. The function computes floor((serverTime-anchor)/interval) without a lower clamp, so anchor>serverTime produces negative ticks and can subtract client-local balance. Rebase-to-now makes elapsed zero and is balance-neutral.

backend_modifications_checked.backend_change: Super daily-limit restoration must occur before MID1 detail[112]
backend_modifications_checked.finding: WorldMap login directly assigns each Super row's dailyLimit/resetCount from the bundled LOAD_WORLD_MAP payload; stale 0/3 in MID1 would remain authoritative until explicitly replaced.

backend_modifications_checked.backend_change: clock regression remains no-grant; logging only adds server-side observability
backend_modifications_checked.finding: Client time is server-seeded and daily timer fanout depends on the server-time model. No source evidence authorizes reopening an already-materialized daily entitlement after server clock regression; Pass79 high-water behavior remains unchanged.
